value: Rural Solar Mini-Grid Operations Dataset in Southern Nigeria, 2020 to 2025
Tam Kemabonta and Abiye Geoffrey

Daily electricity use per smart meter, daily site totals, customer-level payment records, customer attributes and tariff information for one rural solar mini-grid in southern Nigeria, with site description, equipment, capital cost, operating cost lines, tariffs, an outage log with reliability indices, and meter communications uptime. All identifiers are replaced by codes.
Smart-meter and payment system export from the mini-grid's management platform.
Southern Nigeria (rural community; no more precise location is given).
RMG01

Per-meter daily readings 2020-08-26 to 2025-01-25 (1,614 days, 1,576 with data). Payments 2020-07-17 to 2025-01-26. Community daily series 2022-06-06 to 2025-01-25. Meter communications uptime reports 2020-08-26 to 2026-10-24 (communications only; usage and payments end in January 2025).
Daily. No hourly or sub-daily data exists in this dataset.
Energy in kWh. Money in Nigerian naira (NGN).
UTC+01:00 (West Africa Time). All dates are local calendar dates.
133 meters with readings; 142 customer-meter links (Meter_Customer_Link); 248 customer codes; 6 agent codes; 142,450 meter-days; 21,300 payment records.
Sum of per-meter kWh 25,050.9; PAY payments NGN 7,499,650 (19,769 payments).

Names, phone numbers, payment references, SIM numbers, coordinates, balances and the real meter, customer and agent identifiers are removed. Identifiers are replaced by codes (RMG01-Mnnnn, RMG01-Cnnnn, RMG01-Axx) assigned with a fixed random seed; the mapping key is withheld. Dates only, no times (the outage log keeps local clock times of events). Classes BUS and INS merged into non-residential; customers with no class in the source are treated as residential. No customer price column is included. Creation date reduced to year. The smallest class group is 18 customers; year created has two groups below 5 (2022: 4 customers, 2025: 1 customer), and the 3 customers that appear in payment records only have no creation year (see the README for group sizes). The site description, equipment, capital cost, operating cost, tariff and reliability tables hold operator-level figures only: no names, place names, coordinates or account numbers.
Site RMG01; meters RMG01-Mnnnn; customers RMG01-Cnnnn; agents RMG01-Axx. Real identifiers are withheld. Meter_Customer_Link uses the same codes. Details in Data_Dictionary.
